task: P2X2 hidden-state allostery: input-protocol identifiability audit

claims.exact_statement_and_assumptions: For a finite-state kinetic model with a mirror permutation P such that Q_thetaM(c)=P^-1 Q_theta(c) P for every spatially uniform ligand concentration c, initial row distribution pi_thetaM=pi_theta P, and scalar current emission g_thetaM=P^-1 g_theta, all common time-varying ligand protocols induce exactly the same scalar current path law under theta and thetaM. Under equal prior odds, current-only data cannot orient the mirror pair with success above 1/2.
claims.status: conditional_theorem; proof is internal matrix-conjugacy/path-relabeling argument. P2X2 mirror modes are source-reported; full symbolic conjugacy for the complete Scheme IX rate and emission tables remains unverified.
claims.novelty_boundary: The source paper already reports the macroscopic-current mirror ambiguity for its ATP protocols and resolves labels with molecular dynamics. This report extends that reported symmetry to arbitrary uniform input schedules conditional on the exact generator conjugacy. No novelty or priority claim is made; this is an experiment-design corollary, not an externally validated new allostery law.
claims.costs: Existing P2X2 study: 0.2 ms ATP pulses at 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 10 mM plus interleaved 10 ms pulses; n=5-12 patch recordings per concentration/protocol; reported MCMC convergence runs 12-52 days on 16-32 CPU cores. Resolving orientation requires a chain-resolved readout or calibrated symmetry-breaking intervention; construct, labeling, patch, and calibration costs are lab-specific and were not measured here.
claims.falsifier: For an exact mirrored parameter pair satisfying the stated generator, initial-state, and emission relations, any uniform-input current dataset has a non-unit likelihood ratio after all state labels and detector handling are accounted for. Such a difference falsifies at least one symmetry premise or the asserted mirror mapping.
claims.next_gate: Enumerate the full Scheme IX transition, initial-state, and emission mappings from the public model code and verify conjugacy symbolically for all ligand concentrations. If confirmed, compare the mirror pair using a chain-tagged rotation reporter in a P2X2 concatemer with label-swapped controls; retain total current as a matched readout.
